dates: June 1-30 00 UTC initialization in each year
forecast: Hash-verified NOAA GEFS control-member 0.25-degree precipitation selected messages, regional 10-22 N 68-80 E grid
reference: Locally held hash-verified IMD 0.25-degree daily rainfall, 03-03 UTC, valid date at product window end
same_case_rule: On strict-pass cases, masked and canonical rainfall and eligible-cell metrics must be exactly equal. On strict-fail cases, report mask-only coverage and skill descriptively; never impute or create a fictional strict comparator.
missing_cell_rule: Materially negative nested differences become NaN; within-packing-bound negatives become zero. Missing cells never contribute to a rainfall score, a district mean, or a district probability.
district_rule: Use hash-verified existing regional area weights. Report weighted valid area fraction per district and lead. A prospective district value requires at least 0.95 valid weighted area; below that it must be withheld, never filled as zero.
reported_measures: observed rainfall and event frequency at invalid versus valid cells
raw RMSE, mean bias, heavy and very-heavy contingency counts on masked valid cells
selection_rule: No model or QC promotion from this study. A future release requires a separate versioned full-pipeline protocol, nonnegative finite outputs on supported cells, same-case verification and honest partial district/API semantics.
interpretation: Development and validation diagnostic, not an independent performance test or a forecast product.
